insight: Rebranded from no-code legal-doc startup Documate in 2023; now used by nearly 2,000 legal organizations across 23 countries.
name: Gavel
tagline: No-code legal document automation plus AI contract drafting and review for lawyers.
description: Gavel pairs Gavel Workflows — a no-code platform that turns intake answers into finished Word documents and PDFs — with Gavel Exec, an AI contract reviewer and drafter that runs both as a Microsoft Word add-in and on the web. Exec applies a firm's own playbooks and precedent to generate first-pass reviews, redlines, and clauses, benchmark language against market standards, and run batch analysis across portfolios of contracts.
edge: Combines no-code legal-document automation (Workflows) with an in-Word and web AI contract reviewer (Exec) driven by a firm's own playbooks and precedent.
pros: AI contract review in Word and on web

references.title: Gavel Launches Web-Based AI Contract Platform
